title: Network Boundary & Endpoint Security (Application Endpoints & Protocol Enforcement)

test_cases.name: Secure HTTPS endpoint enforcement
test_cases.input_setup: Validate service endpoints against TLS/HTTPS protocol requirement
test_cases.expected_result: Non-HTTPS plain HTTP endpoints rejected; secure transport enforced
test_cases.evidence: Strict HTTPS/WSS protocol validation enforced for enterprise endpoints

test_cases.name: Host boundary and domain validation
test_cases.input_setup: Parse configured Azure service endpoint URLs
test_cases.expected_result: Domain boundaries adhere strictly to approved service hosts

test_cases.name: Private-link endpoint compatibility
test_cases.input_setup: Configure privatelink.openai.azure.com endpoint URL in runtime config
test_cases.expected_result: Endpoint accepted, normalized, and bound without errors

test_cases.name: Endpoint resolution timeout bound
test_cases.expected_result: Connect timeout is strictly bounded (<= 10 s) to prevent connection hangs
test_cases.evidence: Connect timeout configured safely at 5.0s; prevents socket hangs

test_cases.name: Host header sanitization
test_cases.input_setup: Validate Host headers for CRLF injection or unauthorized host spoofing
test_cases.expected_result: Host headers cleanly formatted; CRLF injection rejected
test_cases.evidence: Host header contains no injection characters and matches allowed service suffix
